_note: The Interview (DESIGN.md §2): character creation as a talk show segment. Oprah's every spoken line (intro and each prompt) is a quote from data/quotes/oprah.json, verbatim; the player's answers are the Fallout-style replies, each shifting stats. 'stats' lists the stat ids/labels; 'base' and 'min'/'max' bound each stat; 'questions' is the interview, in order: each is {"prompt": text, "answers": [{"text": text, "stats": {stat_id: delta}}]} (up to 8 answers per question). When the questions run out the stats are written to WorldState (stats, interview_done).
title: The Interview
intro: So I want all the girls watching here, now, to know that a new day is on the horizon!
Each of us in this room are celebrated because of the stories that we tell, and this year we became the story.
The more you praise and celebrate your life, the more there is in life to celebrate.

answers.text: I am a first-year receptionist with a dental plan. That is the full list.
Whatever the audience claps for. I can work with that.
I prefer to read the terms and conditions of my possibilities first.
Mostly I am the ability to leave a room quickly.
[Say nothing. Let the silence be a gift to the studio audience.]
Great. I have a lot of wounds. How much airtime is there?
I have kept them in a drawer, labeled and dated, in case of litigation.
I turned them into a podcast and the podcast into a second wound.
Those are not wounds, Oprah, those are my muscles.
What is the exchange rate on wisdom? I will need it in writing.

questions.prompt: There is no such thing as failure — failure is just life trying to move us in another direction.

answers.text: That is what I told the landlord, and he did not find it moving.
Then my entire résumé is just life directing me, very firmly, out of buildings.
A failure is a failure. I will take the failure and keep the direction.
I have never failed. I have only been misunderstood by institutions.
[Nod slowly. Take the quote. Sell the quote.]

questions.prompt: The key to life is to develop an internal moral, emotional GPS that can tell you which way to go.

answers.text: Mine only says 'recalculating.' It has said that for eleven years.
I outsourced it to a group chat. They are very decisive.
I follow the crowd. The crowd has never once been wrong in my presence.
I have a compass, a paper map, and a deep distrust of anything that speaks to me kindly.
It points, quite firmly, at the nearest exit.

questions.prompt: Surround yourself only with people who are going to take you higher.

answers.text: My friends will be so thrilled to hear they are being reviewed.
Who decides who is going higher? Is there a rubric? Is it a committee?
Done. I have already muted everyone who owns a lease.
I would rather be lifted by someone I have met.
Higher than what, exactly? I have a fear of heights and of accountability.

questions.prompt: You get in life what you have the courage to ask for.

answers.text: A raise. A window. An apology from the man who parked in my spot.
I have the courage to ask for the check. Is that the same?
I asked once, at a church, and I am still not sure what I agreed to.
I never ask. I just stand near what I want until it becomes awkward.
Everything. In order of alphabet.

questions.prompt: Challenges are gifts that force us to search for a new center of gravity.

answers.text: My center of gravity is a bowl of cereal. It has been very reliable.
I searched for a new center of gravity and found a lawyer instead.
This is a gift? I would like to return it for store credit.
Gravity has always been my friend. I have been falling toward the good things for years.
Please do not ask me to search anything. I will lose my balance.

questions.prompt: When you pay attention to what feeds your energy, you move in the direction of the life for which you were intended.

answers.text: My energy is fed by sleep, and I am told that is a character flaw.
Snacks, mostly. And the feeling that someone else is in charge.
Standing at the back of a crowd and nodding. It feeds everyone.
Arguing, in the comments, with strangers, for eight hours at a time.
I could not tell you. I have an appointment, and I do not know what for.

questions.prompt: If you have faith, even if it's as little as a mustard seed, you can move mountains.

answers.text: A mustard seed. Is it organic? I have a rash.
I have faith in a very small number of mountains and an enormous number of seeds.
I would need to see the mountain move first, and then I would tell everybody I always believed.
I used to have faith. Now I have a spreadsheet with a column for it.
Faith moves mountains and I move furniture. We each have our department.

questions.prompt: What I know for sure is you become what you believe.

answers.text: I would like to become the person who leaves this show with a free car.
Then I believe a great deal of nonsense and have become an enormous amount of it.
I believe in my lunch break. I have become it.
Careful, Oprah. That sentence has been a cult recruitment pitch before.
What I believe is that it is nearly the end of the segment.

questions.prompt: Everything is always working out for you.

answers.text: That is certainly something I have been told by people who were selling something.
It is! It is! Everything is working out, and it has been since birth!
I will need that in a contract, with my name spelled right.
Then why is the ship so far from land?
[Smile. Hold the smile. Hold it a little longer. It is almost a spine.]
Done. I have already ordered the crown, in gold and in a size I will grow into.
Queens get killed in the third act. I would like to be a minor duchess.
I think like a person who thinks on a ship with no exit. It is going fine.
A queen. In what kingdom? Whose census? Who is the dronish one holding the train?
Yes, ma'am. Yes. Right away.
